Интерлейкин-6 Profile Interleukin-6 is one of a number of polypeptides known collec- tively as interleukins (p.2325). It is produced by many cell types and induces differentiation of B-lymphocytes and activation of T-cells. It has proinflammatory and pyrogenic properties and is involved in the regulation of immune responses and inflamma- tion. Interleukin-6 has also been implicated in haematopoiesis. Atexakin alfa is human recombinant interleukin-6 under investi- gation. Since overproduction of interleukin-6 plays a crucial role in the pathogenesis of chronic inflammatory diseases, interleukin-6 an- tibodies (p.2326) and interleukin-6 receptor antagonists (p.2326) are being investigated or used as therapeutic agents.
